summary: @umacloud/cli-darwin-x64 preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated 727KB bundle
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs fetches the Bun runtime (v1.3.13) as a zip from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases, extracts it to a tmpdir, chmods the binary executable, and invokes it against `math_init.js` — a 727KB `@bun @bun-cjs`-compiled JS file shipped at the tarball root that carries a string-array-shuffle obfuscator (WV8StW rotation, `_0x`-style identifiers, a ~1000-entry constant array). package.json's `files` whitelist declares only `bin/`, so both `setup.mjs` and `math_init.js` are shipped outside the declared manifest. The result is that `npm install` automatically fetches an alternate language runtime and uses it to execute a large opaque bundle whose behavior is deliberately unreadable to Node-based reviewers, without user consent. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper shape: the second runtime is introduced specifically to run sibling code (`math_init.js`) that a Node-focused review pipeline will not analyze, and the payload is heavily obfuscated and undeclared in the publish manifest.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
